messages:
Erin (deploy): :rotating_light: Noticing spike in 5xx from canary after the small routing change (commit 9f3b2d4). Canary nodes showing ~30% errors on /v1/generate
Maya (oncall): paging @maya 1s Im on it, will gather logs and alert SREs
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-775 opened for elevated error rates in canary region (priority: P2)
Sam (platform): Quick summary pls (sha + what changed) so I can triage rollout state
Erin (deploy): sha=9f3b2d4, change was to header-based routing fallback in multi-tenant handler. Deployed from pipeline hotpatch/small-route at 1937654200
Zach (sre): Confirming 502s in upstream when fallback handler executes. Stack: KeyError: 'tenant_id' at routing/handler.py:142. Looks like an unguarded dict access when header missing.
Olivia (support): Two customers (A and B) reported timeouts ~3m ago; they're waiting for ETA.
Maya (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) flip feature-flag kill-switch for routing.patch (lowest risk) 2) if errors persist -> revert commit 9f3b2d4 and roll out revert 3) post-incident tests. @deploy-bot, whats the flag path?
deploy-bot: Feature flag `routing.patch` present in LaunchDarkly. Kill endpoint: POST /flags/routing.patch/kill (supports dry-run param).
Sam (platform): I'll flip the flag across canary now. Running API call.
Sam (platform): `curl -X POST https://ff-api/flags/routing.patch/kill -H "Authorization: Bearer ***"` -> 200 OK
Erin (deploy): Watching metrics: canary 5xx dropping 30% -> 12% -> 3% within ~45s :white_check_mark:
Zach (sre): Nice. I'll tail logs for residual 502s and watch for retries causing downstream latency. Need 5m of stable metrics.
Olivia (support): Sending customer update: "We're aware of elevated errors after a small routing change; we've disabled the change and services are returning to normal. We'll follow up with a full RCA in ~48h." Include conservative ETA ~30m?
Maya (oncall): Yes, set ETA ~30m for verification and then we can downgrade severity. If errors reappear we'll escalate to rollback.
Erin (deploy): Observing stability even on the tiny prod rollouts that saw the change. Error budget not breached. Still planning to revert the commit and re-run the smoke tests before reintroducing.
Sam (platform): Preparing revert PR and quick CI. Plan: git revert, run smoke tests, then ephemeral canary. Creating PR now.
Sam (platform): PR #482 created (revert-9f3b2d4). Kicking off `bazel test //services/routing:smoke` (approx 3m).
deploy-bot: CI for PR #482 finished: smoke tests PASSED.
Zach (sre): Since flag kill restored traffic, we can deploy revert during this window. I'll keep monitoring while you apply.
Sam (platform): Deploy steps for audit:
``nkubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/routing-service --to-revision=142
```
And repo actions:
``ngit revert --no-edit 9f3b2d4
git push origin hotfix/revert-9f3b2d4
```
Sam (platform): Starting canary deploy of revert PR #482 at 1937654500 (canary = 5%).
Erin (deploy): Paste the exact k8s commands used into the incident for post-incident audit.
Sam (platform): Pasted above and documented in PR.
Zach (sre): Canary metrics post-revert: 5xxs down to 0.8%, latency back to baseline. No new error signatures.
Olivia (support): Updated customers: "Root cause identified as missing guard in new routing path; change reverted and services restored. Monitoring continues; full RCA to follow." (customers A,B)
Maya (oncall): Downgrading severity to monitoring. Timeline: opened 1937654200, flag kill 1937654280, revert deploy 1937654500, normalized by 1937654560.
Erin (deploy): Recording short blameless action items: add unit test for tenant guard, add e2e for header-less requests, implement an auto-kill feature that triggers on >10% 5xx in 1m for new feature flags.
Sam (platform): Attaching PR #482 and smoke logs to the incident ticket.
deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-775 marked RESOLVED by Sam at 1937654741 (monitoring -> resolved)
Maya (oncall): Handoff notes: if any escalations hit support, page me immediately. Otherwise schedule postmortem with dev, SRE, and support owners in 48h.
Olivia (support): I'll close and update customer-facing tickets and drop links to PR/incident when the RCA is posted.
Zach (sre): I'll push a small guard and unit test to dev and reference this incident.
Erin (deploy): Great runbook work and quick coordination everyone. We'll write up the RCA and link here. :thumbsup: (Maya added :eyes: reaction)
